# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

## In the news

Read the latest press releases and media mentions.
[ Explore newsroom ][92]

## Insights

Access the newest in thought leadership.
[ Explore insights ][93]

# Careers with purpose

With a global presence and 44,000+ team members strong, AmerisourceBergen is committed to making a
difference in the future of health.
[ Explore careers ][94]
[GettyImages-1178

## Healthcare Professionals

Committed to helping you enhance your practice and the experience of your patients through connected
devices and digitalised data sharing.

[Healthcare Professionals][9]
* [ Primary Care ][10]
  
  Supporting every aspect of your clinical practice, including physical exam, diagnostic cardiology,
  vitals monitoring and vision screening
* [ Hospital Care ][11]
  
  Advancing products and technologies designed to speed patient recovery and streamline clinical
  workflows
* [ Surgical Care ][12]
  
  Delivering innovations that enable reduced operating times, faster patient recovery and improved
  outcomes
* [ Nutritional Care ][13]
  
  Personalizing nutritional care designed to improve patients’ health in the hospital, the ICU and
  at home
* [ Respiratory Health ][14]
  
  Helping your patients with respiratory therapies designed to simplify delivery and improve
  mobility
* [ Our Products & Services ][15]
  
  Our portfolio of acute, nutritional, hospital and surgical care products helps advance healthcare
  around the world.

## Perspectives

For nearly a century, we have worked at the intersection of saving and sustaining lives.

[Perspectives][16]
* [ Patients' Stories ][17]
  
  Patients’ journeys inspire our work and drive our commitment.

  Enriching the communities where we live and work.

## Our Story

Our 90-year heritage gives us distinct perspective on the needs of patients and caregivers. We lead
today by putting those insights to work to deliver new, better healthcare solutions and access to
care in the communities where we live and work.

[Our Story][21]
* [ Our Leadership ][22]
  
  Our forward-looking leadership team is a driving force in ensuring we meet the needs of all our
  stakeholders – every day and everywhere.
* [ Our Governance ][23]
  
  We are proud of our strong commitment to maintaining the highest standards of corporate
  governance.
* [ Fueling Collaborative Innovation ][24]
  
  Nurturing a culture of innovation is critical to delivering on our mission to save and sustain
  lives. We partner with the healthcare community to continually find more efficient, smarter ways
  to help solve the world's most pressing healthcare challenges.

  We strive to create lasting value by delivering sustainable healthcare, advancing climate and
  resiliency, and championing our people and communities.

  We are committed to attracting, motivating and retaining an inclusive and diverse workforce.
* [ Our History ][27]
  
  For nearly a century, we’ve been focused on saving and sustaining lives and elevating patient
  care.

Helping you reach a healthy life, full of possibility.

[Patients][28]

  Whether you are receiving care in the hospital, at your doctor’s office or at home, we are here to
  support every step of your journey.

  When medical conditions prevent you from adequately feeding yourself, we provide life-saving
  clinical nutrition options to help you regain your nutritional status.
* [ Respiratory Health ][31]
  
  We are committed to helping you with innovative products that deliver effective, proven
  respiratory therapy in the hospital and at home.

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

[See how we’re connecting care][52]


[Patient pictured kneeling next to her Golden Retriever]
[Patient Story][53]

### From Pump to Pup: Finding Comfort in 'Baxter'

Izzy, a young cancer fighter and survivor, loves her dog, Baxter, named after the brand she saw on
the infusion pumps that delivered her chemotherapy.

[Read More][54]
[nurse smiling and standing next to a window ]
[Healthcare Insights][55]

### Technology and Service Support Chronic Disease Management at Home

Conditions such as hypertension, respiratory illnesses and cardiac issues can be monitored
effectively with innovative tools and connected devices.

[Read More][56]
[group event at a baseball game]
[People of Baxter][57]

### The Power of Teamwork to Support Patient Care

Teams bridged the pandemic and borders to bring an innovative ICU bed to life.

[Read More][58]
[Collage of images showing innovations in a manufacturing setting]
[Healthcare Insights][59]

### Supply Chain Innovation Delivers More Nimble, Efficient Solutions

Leaders from Baxter speak about our evolutions in manufacturing and supply chain processes as we
emerge from the COVID-19 pandemic

[Read More][60]
[Kim sitting at her desk smiling]
[People of Baxter][61]

### A Teacher at Heart

After losing her parents to heart disease, Kim resolved to share her knowledge about cardiac
monitoring with HCPs to identify potential issues early.

[Read More][62]
[Chabot graphic]
[Healthcare Insights][63]

### Dr. Chatbot Will See You Now

What role will AI play in healthcare in the future? We believe there are realistic opportunities for
AI to make healthcare more efficient and effective

[Read More][64]
[ Press Release ][65]

### Baxter Publishes 2025 Sustainability Report Highlighting Refreshed Strategy, Ongoing Commitment
### to Drive Meaningful Impact

[Read More][66]
[ Press Release ][67]

### Baxter Reports First-Quarter 2026 Results

[Read More][68]
[ Press Release ][69]

### Baxter Showcases Recent Innovations at AORN Global Surgical Conference and Expo 2026

[Read More][70]

## Our Commitment to Healthcare Professionals and Patients

We are committed to supporting patients and healthcare professionals with innovations that are
driven by compassion for their journeys, a passion to improve care and the ambition to transform the
future of healthcare.

[A doctor in a hospital room looks off to the side]

## Products for Healthcare Professionals

### Primary Care [ Primary Care Go to Primary Care ][71]

Supporting every aspect of your clinical practice, including physical exam, diagnostic cardiology,
vitals monitoring and vision screening

[ Go to Primary Care ][72]

### Hospital Care [ Hospital Care Go to Hospital Care ][73]

Advancing products and technologies designed to speed patient recovery and streamline clinical
workflows

[ Go to Hospital Care ][74]

### Surgical Care [ Surgical Care Go to Surgical Care ][75]

Delivering innovations that enable reduced operating times, faster patient recovery and improved
outcomes

[ Go to Surgical Care ][76]

### Nutritional Care [ Nutritional Care Go to Nutritional Care ][77]

Personalizing nutritional care designed to improve patients’ health in the hospital, the ICU and at
home

[ Go to Nutritional Care ][78]

### Respiratory Care [ Respiratory Care Go to Respiratory Care ][79]

Helping your patients with respiratory therapies designed to simplify delivery and improve mobility

[ Go to Respiratory Care ][80]

### Our Products [ Our Products Go to Our Products ][81]

Enabling clinicians to treat patients more efficiently and effectively across care settings,
including in the office-based practice, inpatient care, outpatient care and at home

[ Go to Our Products ][82]
[Two ladies have a discussion in a coffee shop]

## For Patients

You are our passion. Your stories inspire us to work harder at bringing innovations that can make
your experience easier, speed recovery and enable the best possible quality of life.

[Discover Patient Stories][83]

### More For Patients

### General Healthcare [ General Healthcare Go to General Healthcare ][84]

Whether you are receiving care in the hospital, at your doctor’s office or at home, we are here to
support every step of your journey.

[ Go to General Healthcare ][85]

### Nutritional Care [ Nutritional Care Go to Nutritional Care ][86]

When medical conditions prevent you from adequately feeding yourself, we provide clinical nutrition
options to help you regain your nutritional status.

[ Go to Nutritional Care ][87]

### Respiratory Care [ Respiratory Care Go to Respiratory Care ][88]

We are committed to helping you with innovative products that deliver effective, proven respiratory
therapy in the hospital and at home.

[ Go to Respiratory Care ][89]

## Bringing our Purpose to Life

Our mission to save and sustain lives is reflected in our business priorities and our commitment to
be an agent of change at a global level. This means doing what is right for our planet, our patients
and customers, our teams and our communities. We put this commitment into action through high-impact
philanthropy, diversity, equity and inclusion, nurturing partnerships with the healthcare community
and striving for the highest standards of corporate responsibility.

### Our Leadership

Our forward-looking leadership team is a driving force in ensuring we meet our commitments – every
day and everywhere.

[Learn More About Our Leadership][90]

### Our Corporate Responsibility

For nearly a century, we have made a meaningful difference in global healthcare while creating
lasting value for the communities we serve.

[Learn More About Our Corporate Responsibility][91]

### Careers

This is where an inclusive community of diverse individuals is driven to go beyond what is, to what
is possible in healthcare.

[Learn More About Careers at Baxter][92]

### Our History

For more than 90 years, we’ve been focused on our commitment to save and sustain lives with
innovations that elevate patient care, improve outcomes and drive healthcare transformation.

[Learn More About Our History][93]

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

everyone’s mental health.

# Building a world of health around every individual

We connect people to the care they need, put medicine and wellness within reach, and drive greater
affordability, simplicity and convenience in everything we do.

## Combining our strengths for you

Health services Health insurance Pharmacy Prescription drug coverage

### Health services

We have an unmatched ability to reach people and provide them with access to the affordable, quality
health care and wellbeing services they need to live their healthiest lives.

[Explore our services ][110]

### Health insurance

Aetna® creates insurance plans that deliver a total, connected, affordable approach to health care.

[Discover Aetna plans ][111]

### Pharmacy

Our neighborhood pharmacies — as well as our prescription delivery and specialty medication services
— are making it as easy as possible for people to get the care they depend on.

[Visit our pharmacy page ][112]

### Prescription drug coverage

Our pharmacy benefit manager, CVS Caremark®, plays a critical role in the health care system by
helping to lower drug costs and expand coverage to the affordable medications people need to stay
healthy.

[Learn about drug coverage ][113]

### View transcript

Having 1 kid?...Not exactly simple.

Having 6 kids? Definitely not simple. Wait, that’s 8 people in one family. Whoa.

That means finding ONE tv show they’ll ALL watch.

Making ONE dinner they’ll ALL eat.

And how do you play a board game with 6 kids?…actually, that’s kinda simple.

Okaaay, not so simple.

But it’s not just tantrums.

It’s attitudes.

That’s right. Teenagers.

And how do you decide who gets the last piece of pizza?

But you don’t just have 6 kids, you have 6 kids all with chronic illnesses.

That means on top of it all, you have to manage over 50 prescriptions, medical checkups, and support
everyone’s mental health.

Luckily, you’re not alone…I mean Tricia, obviously YOU’RE not alone.

But you’ve also got CVS Health as your healthcare partner, to manage specialty medications, provide
walk-in appointments, and keep track of it all in the CVS Health app.

So, does that make everything…simple?

No. It makes it simple…er

And sometimes, “simpler” is all you need to live a little happier and healthier.

But who gets the last piece of pizza? That’s still your call.

When you need more than a pharmacy…
CVS Health.
Healthier Happens Together.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]
[Person in a blue McKesson-branded jacket with arms crossed, standing in an industrial or warehouse
setting.]

### [ Pharmaceutical & Medical Supplies Distribution Services ][127]

[Pharmacist in a white coat holding a prescription bottle in a pharmacy, with shelves of medications
and the word PHARMACY visible in the background.]

### [ Pharmacy Services ][128]

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

# See what your competitors
# will do next.

While others chase press releases and earnings calls, we capture real intelligence from the data
trails companies leave behind unknowingly — whether competitors, acquisition targets, potential
partners, or emerging disruptors.

Book a Demo

## Trusted by teams at

[Intuit][S2A][Eleventh Hour Group][Abridge]
The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

How it works

Each step compresses the input. Thousands of raw signals collapse into a handful of patterns, then
into a single forecast you can act on.

  patterns. We connect signals across sources — hiring spikes, doc changes, ad shifts, partnership
  chatter — to surface the combinations that actually mean something.
  Predictions

  PredictFrom the patterns, we forecast what's coming next — product launches, market entries,

  move before it's made, not after the press release.

## The Gavi Leap

## The Gavi Leap

The Gavi Leap is the most ambitious reform agenda in global health, offering a blueprint for broader
reform of the health and development architecture. Learn more about how Leap principles, such as
country ownership, radical simplification and innovation, are already having a tangible impact on
how immunisation is delivered in Gavi-supported countries.

[Latest on the Leap][196]
[The Gavi Leap]

## Our work

[A mother with her child in Tanzania. Credit: Doune Porter]

### Vaccine portfolio

Gavi supports vaccines against 20 infectious diseases, including Ebola, malaria, mpox and rabies.

[View our vaccines][197]

[A health worker in Tanzania. Credit: Gavi/2012/P Rudden]

### Health systems support

Strong health and immunisation systems are vital to deliver vaccines to all the children who need
them.

[Learn more][198]

We provide grants for civil society organisations (CSOs) working to reach zero-dose children and
missed communities with vaccines.

# Next-Generation Vector Vaccines for Swine Health

[Learn More][25]
[Contact Us][26]

## Our Mission

GeminiVax Kft is a Hungarian vaccine-development start-up focused on next-generation veterinary
vaccines for swine health.


Our mission is to reduce losses caused by major viral infections, improve piglet survival and
growth, and support sustainable productivity in modern swine production.


We are developing broad-spectrum veterinary vaccine candidates designed for a changing viral
landscape, where pathogen diversity, strain drift and regional variation increasingly challenge
conventional vaccine approaches.

[Explore][27]
[ChatGPT Image Jul 3, 2026, 12_30_00 PM.webp]

## What we do

GeminiVax develops broadly protective swine vaccine candidates using an advanced attenuated
influenza-virus vector platform originally developed by Capricorn Technologies GmbH.


The platform is designed to deliver carefully selected pathogen-derived immune targets, including
conserved cytotoxic T-cell epitopes and neutralising B-cell epitopes. This allows the development of
compact antigenic cassettes intended to stimulate both cellular and humoral immune responses.


Our strategy is to create vaccines that are less vulnerable to viral mutation, regional strain
variation and changing epidemiological patterns — particularly for respiratory and systemically
transmitted viral diseases of swine.

## Why It Matters

Swine viral diseases remain a major cause of mortality, reduced weight gain, reproductive losses,
secondary infections and increased production costs worldwide. Existing vaccines can be highly
valuable, but many are challenged by viral diversity, strain drift, incomplete cross-protection and
regional epidemiological differences.


GeminiVax is developing vaccine candidates designed to address these limitations through conserved
immune targets, vector-based antigen delivery and rational immune-response design.

## Core Innovative Technologies

##### Vector Platform

GeminiVax applies a double-attenuated influenza-virus vector that can be configured to carry
selected immune targets from pathogens of interest. The vector is intended to support strong
cellular immunity, mucosal responses and flexible antigen-cassette design.

##### Informatics-Guided Epitope Selection

Unique bioinformatics approach for in-silico selection of CTL and B-cell epitopes, prediction of
their relative immunogenic strength, and assembling into pathogen-originated epitope cassettes.

##### Built-In Immune Modulation

Selected immune-response modulators and synthetic adjuvant technologies may be incorporated to
enhance or shape vaccine-induced responses, including dendritic-cell activation and polarisation.

## In Development*

[Swine Flu Virus]

###### SIV Vaccine

A broadly protective vaccine candidate targeting major swine influenza subtypes, including H1N1,
H1N2 and H3N2, across regionally distinct North American, European and Asian lineages.

[Read More][28]
[PRRSV]

###### PRRSV Vaccine

A next-generation vaccine candidate targeting PRRSV-1 and PRRSV-2 across European, North American
and Asian lineages, with focus on conserved targets in variable and emerging variants.

[Read More][29]
[PCV-2]

###### PCV-2 Vaccine

A broadly protective PCV-2 vaccine candidate targeting major circulating genotypes, including PCV2a,
PCV2b and PCV2d, with extended coverage against globally emerging viral variants.

[Read More][30]
[CSFV]

###### CSF Vaccine

A vaccine candidate combining protective immune responses with marker/DIVA potential to support
disease control, surveillance and differentiation of infected from vaccinated animals.

[Read More][31]

## Email Finder FAQ

If you can't find the answer to your question here, visit the dedicated section in our Help Center.

[Visit Help Center][32]

### How should I use the Email Finder?

You may use this search email address tool to find company email addresses, get prospects' valid
emails and other data about them, both on the platform's web app via Search and Enrich and on
LinkedIn via our Email Finder extension (data can also be searched on prospective companies'
websites).

### What data should I upload to find an email address?

To find an email for a prospect, the following data in our web app set is required: first name, last
name, and the company name of the domain (which can be selected from 17 filters). Based on this
information, GetProspect will provide the email address and other prospect data.

### Is it ethical to use an Email Finder?

If you scrape the email addresses for legitimate purposes, such as sales or job hunting, and they
are collected and used in accordance with applicable laws and regulations, it may be considered
ethical. But, if you extract emails for sending spam, phishing, or any other illegal purpose, then
it’s unethical.

### Where does GetProspect find emails?

GetProspect Email finder uses its powerful database of over 200 million business contacts with
emails and 26 million companies to find email addresses, as well as LinkedIn's largest and most
current business contacts database with over 900 million users.

### How accurate is the Email Finder?

The accuracy of valid emails that were found on the platform is 95%.

According to the latest tests, GetProspect Email Finder found 84 valid email addresses out of 100
contacts, which is higher than in such alternatives as ZoomInfo, Hunter.io, Lusha, ContactOut, and
others.

### How can I extract an email address from a website?

The GetProspect company Email Finder extracts business email addresses from any company website.
Once the extension is installed, it can be used for fetching basic info about the companies,
employees' email addresses and getting essential data about them. Just click on the extension icon
to find emails and leads you need by name or job title.

### Is the Getprospect Email Finder a free service?

GetProspect Email Finder provides lifetime access to 50 free new email addresses each month.

### How much does the Email Finder cost?

Paid Email Finder subscriptions start at $49 per month with 1,000 valid emails and 2,000
verifications. You can find email addresses for just $34 per month with an annual payment. Find out
more about it at [Pricing.][33]

Hi, I’m Dima, founder and CEO at GetProspect.

The idea for GetProspect came after talking with a salesperson friend who struggled to find valid

We are building an all-in-one platform that will help businesses to find email addresses and leads,

I hope you’ll feel our love through the product and it will bring true value.

## Email Finder FAQ

If you can't find the answer to your question here, visit the dedicated section in our Help Center.

[Visit Help Center][32]

### How should I use the Email Finder?

You may use this search email address tool to find company email addresses, get prospects' valid
emails and other data about them, both on the platform's web app via Search and Enrich and on
LinkedIn via our Email Finder extension (data can also be searched on prospective companies'
websites).

### What data should I upload to find an email address?

To find an email for a prospect, the following data in our web app set is required: first name, last
name, and the company name of the domain (which can be selected from 17 filters). Based on this
information, GetProspect will provide the email address and other prospect data.

### Is it ethical to use an Email Finder?

If you scrape the email addresses for legitimate purposes, such as sales or job hunting, and they
are collected and used in accordance with applicable laws and regulations, it may be considered
ethical. But, if you extract emails for sending spam, phishing, or any other illegal purpose, then
it’s unethical.

### Where does GetProspect find emails?

GetProspect Email finder uses its powerful database of over 200 million business contacts with
emails and 26 million companies to find email addresses, as well as LinkedIn's largest and most
current business contacts database with over 900 million users.

### How accurate is the Email Finder?

The accuracy of valid emails that were found on the platform is 95%.

According to the latest tests, GetProspect Email Finder found 84 valid email addresses out of 100
contacts, which is higher than in such alternatives as ZoomInfo, Hunter.io, Lusha, ContactOut, and
others.

### How can I extract an email address from a website?

The GetProspect company Email Finder extracts business email addresses from any company website.
Once the extension is installed, it can be used for fetching basic info about the companies,
employees' email addresses and getting essential data about them. Just click on the extension icon
to find emails and leads you need by name or job title.

### Is the Getprospect Email Finder a free service?

GetProspect Email Finder provides lifetime access to 50 free new email addresses each month.

### How much does the Email Finder cost?

Paid Email Finder subscriptions start at $49 per month with 1,000 valid emails and 2,000
verifications. You can find email addresses for just $34 per month with an annual payment. Find out
more about it at [Pricing.][33]

s][5]**    │possibility that HIV-1, the most widespread and deadly human AIDS virus, evolved from│

g][6]**    │SV40 -- the 40^{th} monkey virus ever discovered. This virus, like HIV-1, is         │

           │investigator, Dr. Leonard Horowitz in the award winning book [Emerging Viruses: AIDS │  
           │& Ebola -- Nature, Accident or Intentional?][7] (Tetrahedron Press, 1998;            │  
           │1-888-508-4787; [http:www.tetrahedron.org][8]) Dr. Horowitz unearthed and reprinted  │  
           │stunning scientific documents and National Institutes of Health contracts proving    │  
           │that chimpanzees, contaminated with numerous viruses, were used to produce hundreds  │  
           │of hepatitis B vaccine doses administered to central African Blacks along with       │  
           │homosexual men in New York City at precisely the time Dr. Myers and colleagues claim │  
           │the origin of HIV "punctuated event" occurred.                                       │  
           │                                                                                     │  
           │Unfortunately, as another Royal Society conference presenter, Dr. Julian Cribb,      │  
           │protested, too little attention is given by drug-industry-influenced medical         ├──
           │journals, and the mainstream media, to controversial truths in science regarding the │  
           │origin of HIV and AIDS. (See: Cribb J. The origin of acquired immune deficiency      │  
           │syndrome: can science afford to ignore it? Phil. Trans. R. Soc. Lond B (2001)        │  
           │356:935-938.) As a result, documents such as those published by Dr. Horowitz, and    │  
           │others, showing AIDS apparently derives from contaminated hepatitis B vaccines, have │  
           │never received adequate attention.                                                   │

## Data Insights

Bite-sized insights on how the world is changing, published every few days.

[See all Data Insights][47]
* [
  [Stacked area chart of shares of egg production in the United Kingdom by housing system
  (free-range, cages, barns) from 1996 to 2025 where free-range rises from 10% in 1996 to 75% in
  2025, with cages declining and barns remaining a small share. Source: Defra (2023, 2026). License:
  CC BY.]
  
  Today
  
  ### Three-quarters of eggs produced in the United Kingdom are free-range
  
  Hannah Ritchie and Pablo Rosado
  
  Growing up in the United Kingdom in the 1990s and early 2000s, almost all the eggs in our
  supermarket came from battery hens, those raised in small wire enclosures.
  
  The living conditions in these cages are terrible. Birds get the space equivalent of an A4 sheet
  of paper. They don’t have the room to carry out their natural behaviors, such as nesting,
  perching, or dust bathing.
  
  That has changed in recent decades. You can see this in the chart, which shows the conditions
  under which eggs are produced in the UK. Free-range eggs have increased from just 10% to 75%.
  
  The use of caged hens has fallen, and the types of caged enclosures have also changed. Battery
  cages were banned in 2012, so legally, all cages since then have been “enriched” ones, which
  provide slightly more space. Still, these do not give hens the freedom and room they’d have in
  barns or free-range farms. Studies suggest that moving hens from enriched cages to cage-free
  systems reduces the time they spend in pain by more than half.
  
  And given that most eggs in the UK are now free-range, it’s possible to reduce this pain even
  further.
  
  Read my article on what the conditions of hens look like under caged versus cage-free systems
  Continue reading
  ][48]
* [
  [Line chart of annual global population growth rate (percentage) where growth peaked at 2.3% in
  1963, fell to less than 1% by 2020, and UN projections show rates declining toward zero and
  becoming negative by 2100, implying a shrinking global population. Source: UN, World Population
  Prospects (2024). License: CC BY.]
  
  July 23
  
  ### Global population growth peaked six decades ago
  
  Esteban Ortiz-Ospina and Pablo Arriagada
  
  The increase in the world’s population is not exponential. The global population is growing, but
  the growth rate has declined since its peak six decades ago.
  
  The chart shows the annual rate of global population growth according to historical estimates and
  projections from the UN World Population Prospects.
  
  The growth rate peaked in 1963 at over 2% per year, and since then, it has more than halved,
  falling to less than 1% by 2020.
  
  The UN demographers expect rates to continue falling until the end of the century, eventually
  leading to negative growth rates and a shrinking global population.
  
  Explore how these projections change with different assumptions in our new population simulation
  tool
  Continue reading
  ][49]
* [
  [Horizontal bar chart of medical doctors per 1,000 people by country income group, where
  high-income countries have about 3.78 doctors per 1,000 and low-income countries about 0.38,
  showing roughly ten times more doctors in rich than poor countries. Data for 2022 from Global
  Health Workforce Statistics, WHO, via World Bank (2026). License: CC BY.]
  
  July 21
  
  ### Rich countries have ten times as many doctors per person as poor ones
  
  Hannah Ritchie and Pablo Arriagada
  
  A person’s access to doctors depends heavily on the income level of the country they live in.
  
  High-income countries have around ten times as many doctors per person as low-income ones. You can
  see this in the chart, which shows the number of medical doctors per 1,000 people.
  
  The global average is around 1.9 doctors per 1,000. Low-income countries have around one-fifth of
  that figure.
  
  These figures include generalist physicians and specialists.
  
  Explore more data on healthcare spending and access
  Continue reading
  ][50]
* [
  [Horizontal bar chart of the share of children younger than five years who are stunted across
  Central American and Caribbean countries, where Guatemala is highest at 46% and the other
  countries range from 6.7% to 22%. Source: World Health Organization - Global Health Observatory
  (2026). License: CC BY.]
  
  July 18
  
  ### Nearly half of young children in Guatemala suffer from stunting
  
  Esteban Ortiz-Ospina
  
  Chronic malnutrition in early childhood can slow development and growth, leaving children shorter
  than expected for their age. That’s the focus of the chart: the share of children under five who
  are stunted, meaning they are much shorter than expected for healthy growth.
  
  The consequences of stunting persist beyond childhood, affecting both physical health and
  cognitive development.
  
  Guatemala has one of the highest stunting rates in the world: almost half of children younger than
  five are stunted according to survey estimates published by the World Health Organization.
  
  Guatemala’s rate is the highest in its region, by far. In the chart, you can see it compared to a
  selection of other nearby countries – its rate is twice that of Haiti, the next-highest country
  and a much poorer one.
  
  My colleagues Hannah Ritchie and Tuna Acisu recently wrote about what countries with high stunting
  today can learn from Japan. Over the 20th century, Japan reduced childhood stunting from over 70%
  to under 5%, and the decline from around Guatemala's current level to under 5% took place within a
  generation.
  
  Read their article, “Childhood stunting fell dramatically over the 20th century”
  Continue reading
  ][51]
* [
  [Slopegraph of total fertility rates where the chart compares 1993 and 2023 values for selected
  countries to illustrate convergence in fertility. Most countries show 2023 rates around 1.6 to 1.7
  births per woman, down from 1993 values ranging from 1.8 to 3.8 births per woman. Source: Human
  Fertility Database (2025). License: CC BY.]
  
  July 16
  
  ### Fertility rates across many countries have converged, despite starting from very different
  ### levels
  
  Hannah Ritchie
  
  In the thirty years since I was born, fertility rates in my country, the United Kingdom, have not
  changed much. In 1993, the fertility rate was 1.8 births per woman. Thirty years later, it had
  dropped only slightly, to 1.6 births.
  
  Elsewhere, the change has been much more dramatic; fertility rates have dropped sharply and are
  now similar to those in the UK.
  
  You can see this in the chart, which shows the change in fertility rates from 1993 (in blue) to
  2023 (in red). In Qatar and Iran, rates dropped from almost 4 births per woman to 1.7.
  
  Fertility rates have fallen a lot across Asia and South America, too — Malaysia and Colombia are
  two examples (my colleague Esteban previously wrote about the latter). This marks a much faster
  demographic transition than many countries experienced historically.
  
  Convergence isn’t the whole story, though. Here, I’ve picked countries with fertility rates that
  are similar to the UK’s today. But some have fallen far below these levels: in Chile and Thailand,
  the fertility rate was 1.2 births per woman in 2023, and may have fallen even further.
  
  Explore fertility rates across the world and over time
  Continue reading
  ][52]

  sharp rise after 2020 — the United States shows earlier growth and countries like Colombia,

  July 16
  
  ### Fertility rates across many countries have converged, despite starting from very different
  ### levels
  
  Hannah Ritchie
  
  In the thirty years since I was born, fertility rates in my country, the United Kingdom, have not
  changed much. In 1993, the fertility rate was 1.8 births per woman. Thirty years later, it had
  dropped only slightly, to 1.6 births.
  
  Elsewhere, the change has been much more dramatic; fertility rates have dropped sharply and are
  now similar to those in the UK.
  
  You can see this in the chart, which shows the change in fertility rates from 1993 (in blue) to
  2023 (in red). In Qatar and Iran, rates dropped from almost 4 births per woman to 1.7.
  
  Fertility rates have fallen a lot across Asia and South America, too — Malaysia and Colombia are
  two examples (my colleague Esteban previously wrote about the latter). This marks a much faster
  demographic transition than many countries experienced historically.
  
  Convergence isn’t the whole story, though. Here, I’ve picked countries with fertility rates that
  are similar to the UK’s today. But some have fallen far below these levels: in Chile and Thailand,
  the fertility rate was 1.2 births per woman in 2023, and may have fallen even further.

Looking for straight‑forward facts about a prescription, an over‑the‑counter pill, or a natural
supplement? You’re in the right place. Our team gathers data from trusted sources, strips away the
jargon, and serves you bite‑size answers you can act on today.

## What you’ll find

From allergy relievers like Claritin to chronic‑care drugs such as Decadron, each article includes
uses, dosage tips, safety warnings and buying guides (especially for Australian readers). Need a
supplement rundown? Check out our American ginseng guide or the wintergreen benefits overview.

## Why trust us

We focus on evidence‑based information, keep every page up‑to‑date, and organize content under two
simple categories – Health & Wellness and Medicine. That means you spend less time hunting and more
time understanding what matters for your health.

# Pulitzer Center

## The Pulitzer Center champions the power of stories to make complex issues relevant and inspire
## action.

### JOURNALISM

Through grant and fellowship programs, we provide financial and editorial support, training, and
collaboration networks for journalists to pursue in-depth, high-impact reporting projects.


Journalism

Global stories, local impact

[Journalism][121]


Opportunities for Journalists

Apply for a reporting grant or fellowship

[Opportunities for Journalists][122]


Student Reporting Fellowships

Stories by student journalists

[Student Reporting Fellowships][123]

### ENGAGEMENT

We create communities of learning that amplify Pulitzer Center journalism through education and
outreach programs, connecting teachers, students, artists, influencers, and decision makers with
stories that matter.


K-12 Programs for Teachers and Students

Global education and media literacy programs for U.S. classrooms

[K-12 Programs for Teachers and Students][124]


Campus Consortium

University and community college partnerships in the U.S.

[Campus Consortium][125]


International Education and Outreach

Engagement programs in the Congo Basin, Latin America, and Southeast Asia

[<meta charset="utf-8">International Education and Outreach][126]


Community Events

Worldwide and local convenings, online and in-person

[Community Events][127]

## IMPACT

**We believe in the power of journalism to spur change. **

Pulitzer Center programs have helped change harmful laws and policies; held some of the world’s top
businesses and brands accountable for destructive practices; and equipped citizens with context and
data that illuminate challenges and possible solutions to the complex issues that affect their
lives.

[LEARN MORE][128]

# Pulitzer Center

## The Pulitzer Center champions the power of stories to make complex issues relevant and inspire
## action.

### JOURNALISM

Through grant and fellowship programs, we provide financial and editorial support, training, and
collaboration networks for journalists to pursue in-depth, high-impact reporting projects.


Journalism

Global stories, local impact

[Journalism][121]


Opportunities for Journalists

Apply for a reporting grant or fellowship

[Opportunities for Journalists][122]


Student Reporting Fellowships

Stories by student journalists

[Student Reporting Fellowships][123]

### ENGAGEMENT

We create communities of learning that amplify Pulitzer Center journalism through education and
outreach programs, connecting teachers, students, artists, influencers, and decision makers with
stories that matter.


K-12 Programs for Teachers and Students

Global education and media literacy programs for U.S. classrooms

[K-12 Programs for Teachers and Students][124]


Campus Consortium

University and community college partnerships in the U.S.

[Campus Consortium][125]


International Education and Outreach

Engagement programs in the Congo Basin, Latin America, and Southeast Asia

[<meta charset="utf-8">International Education and Outreach][126]


Community Events

Worldwide and local convenings, online and in-person

[Community Events][127]

## IMPACT

**We believe in the power of journalism to spur change. **

Pulitzer Center programs have helped change harmful laws and policies; held some of the world’s top
businesses and brands accountable for destructive practices; and equipped citizens with context and
data that illuminate challenges and possible solutions to the complex issues that affect their
lives.

[LEARN MORE][128]

crowd of other people also raising similar sticks.]

# **Children in Crisis**

UNICEF is on the ground across the globe, delivering help for the children who need it most.

## Featured Stories

[View All][109]
[
[A UNICEF-supported psychosocial worker entertains a baby at an Ebola treatment center in Bunia,
Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of Congo.]

with vital health information. [video]

Farchana, eastern Chad with a UNICEF-provided backpack full of supplies to help him learn. ]

## Helping Children Get Back to School: How UNICEF Expands **Education Access**

][112]
[
[A mother and father at home in Ethiopia with their infant child.]

## How Economic Shocks From War in the Middle East Threaten to **Increase Child Poverty Worldwide**

][113]

## Relentlessly Pursuing a More Equitable World for Every Child

UNICEF has helped save and meaningfully improve more children’s lives than any other humanitarian
organization. UNICEF won’t stop until every child is [healthy][114], [educated][115],
[protected][116] and [respected][117].

[A 5-year-old boy receives the polio vaccine from Shumaila, a UNICEF-supported polio vaccinator in
Lahore, Pakistan on January 11, 2021. ]

## Healthy

UNICEF workers brave war zones, treacherous terrain, disasters and disease to save lives and make
the world safe for kids.
[Read more][118]
[ A UNICEF-supported teacher and one of her students stand in front of the chalkboard at a school in
Mali.]

## Educated

UNICEF helps children continue their education through community-based schools, learning support and
other programs.
[Read more][119]
[Children staning in front of a UNICEF tent]

## Protected

UNICEF collaborates with families, partners and governments to ensure children can flourish free
from exploitation and abuse.
[Read more][120]
[Bharti Raju, 5, poses for photograph outside her house at Shirasgaon Mandap village in Jalna,
Maharashtra on Sunday, 19, Oct. 2020.]

## Respected

UNICEF knows children have the most at stake — and works to safeguard their rights and to ensure
their voices are heard.
[Read more][121]
[Lawrene O'Donnell and UNICEF USA's KIND Fund gives Malawi kids desks]

## Kids in Need of Desks

Join MS NOW’s Lawrence O’Donnell and help change a child's life with a simple desk.
[Help Kids Learn][122]
[Baby boy smiling at the camera while being held]

## Monthly Giving

Make a difference for children every day, all year! Monthly support allows UNICEF to be there
whenever needed.
[Donate][123]
[Smiling girls jumping rope]

## Play Can't Wait

UNICEF delivers play — like soccer balls, jump ropes and safe spaces to use them — as essential aid.
Because it is.
[Learn More][124]

## Always There for Children in Crisis

Other organizations help children, but [UNICEF does more][125] by [fighting for children’s
rights][126] and delivering the essentials every child needs for an equitable chance in life.

## Relentlessly Pursuing a More Equitable World for Every Child

UNICEF has helped save and meaningfully improve more children’s lives than any other humanitarian
organization. UNICEF won’t stop until every child is [healthy][114], [educated][115],
[protected][116] and [respected][117].

[A 5-year-old boy receives the polio vaccine from Shumaila, a UNICEF-supported polio vaccinator in
Lahore, Pakistan on January 11, 2021. ]

## Healthy

UNICEF workers brave war zones, treacherous terrain, disasters and disease to save lives and make
the world safe for kids.
[Read more][118]
[ A UNICEF-supported teacher and one of her students stand in front of the chalkboard at a school in
Mali.]

## Educated

UNICEF helps children continue their education through community-based schools, learning support and
other programs.
[Read more][119]
[Children staning in front of a UNICEF tent]

## Protected

UNICEF collaborates with families, partners and governments to ensure children can flourish free
from exploitation and abuse.
[Read more][120]
[Bharti Raju, 5, poses for photograph outside her house at Shirasgaon Mandap village in Jalna,
Maharashtra on Sunday, 19, Oct. 2020.]

## Respected

UNICEF knows children have the most at stake — and works to safeguard their rights and to ensure
their voices are heard.
[Read more][121]
[Lawrene O'Donnell and UNICEF USA's KIND Fund gives Malawi kids desks]

## Kids in Need of Desks

Join MS NOW’s Lawrence O’Donnell and help change a child's life with a simple desk.
[Help Kids Learn][122]
[Baby boy smiling at the camera while being held]

## Monthly Giving

Make a difference for children every day, all year! Monthly support allows UNICEF to be there
whenever needed.
[Donate][123]
[Smiling girls jumping rope]

## Play Can't Wait

UNICEF delivers play — like soccer balls, jump ropes and safe spaces to use them — as essential aid.
Because it is.
[Learn More][124]

## Always There for Children in Crisis

Other organizations help children, but [UNICEF does more][125] by [fighting for children’s
rights][126] and delivering the essentials every child needs for an equitable chance in life.

[Einkorn: The Oldest Ancient Grain Rapidly Gaining Attention from Researchers for Superior Gut
Health][24]
Einkorn is the oldest of the "ancient grains," and its rising popularity in recent years has led to
some interesting findings about this ancient grain, and just how healthy it is. Fortunately, recent
research has looked beyond the modern dogma which claims that the "gluten" found in wheat varieties
is toxic to human health, focusing instead on how wheat is grown and processed, since the gluten
from grains has been a part of the diet of humans for many thousands of years and was always
considered healthy. We have published much of this research ourselves in recent years. More recent
studies, many of them done in Turkey where einkorn (known as Siyez in Turkey) is native, and not an
introduced crop (like in the U.S.), have shown that einkorn is unique in producing lactic acid
bacteria and other "probiotics" necessary for gut health. This is accomplished by using traditional
"sourdough" preparations of the flour. In one study done in Turkey, they added einkorn flour to
"Peksimet", a traditional Turkish twice-baked bread valued for its hard, dry texture, long shelf
life, and role as a durable staple food in Turkish and Turkish-Cypriot cuisine. They found that the
einkorn flour resulted in a significant decrease in the glycemic index, which is important for those
suffering from diabetes or high blood sugar due to the consumption of too many carbohydrates.

vaccines for infectious diseases addressing unmet medical needs. We have leveraged our expertise and
capabilities both to commercialize three vaccines, including a single-shot chikungunya vaccine, and

candidates against Lyme disease, Shigella and Zika.
